# Analog Press

## Overview

Film grain darkroom aesthetic meets typewriter manuscript — vintage print shop warmth. A monochrome reading system warmed by analog grain and print-shop color.

Generated by web-stylebook-mcp from the fusion-grain-mono style. Values come from the pinned visual contract (revision fnv1a:d5fdd6730babc49f). This file describes the dark theme.

Visual profile: typewriter print type, grain monochrome panels, slow archive rhythm.

## Colors

Token names follow DESIGN.md conventions; the name in parentheses is the compose_design_tokens role.

- **primary** (text) `#f1eadf`: Body text and headings.
- **on-primary** (textInverse) `#15100d`: Text on a primary (ink) fill.
- **secondary** (textMuted) `rgba(241, 234, 223, 0.58)`: Secondary text: captions, metadata, helper text.
- **surface** (canvas) `#15100d`: Page background.
- **surface-container** (surface) `#201915`: Panels and cards.
- **surface-container-high** (surfaceRaised) `#201915`: Raised surfaces such as inputs, menus, and popovers.
- **surface-variant** (surfaceMuted) `#201915`: Muted fills such as hover rows, wells, and disabled areas.
- **outline** (borderStrong) `#f1eadf`: Control boundaries that must stay visible.
- **outline-variant** (border) `rgba(241, 234, 223, 0.14)`: Dividers and decorative rules.
- **accent** (accent) `#d2927b`: The style's identity accent.
- **on-accent** (accentText) `#000000`: Text on the accent.
- **accent-secondary** (accentSecondary) `#201915`: Secondary accent for selection and secondary surfaces, not the primary action.
- **on-accent-secondary** (accentSecondaryText) `#f1eadf`: Text on the secondary accent.
- **action-primary** (actionPrimary) `#d2927b`: Primary button fill.
- **on-action-primary** (actionPrimaryText) `#000000`: Primary button label.
- **action-secondary** (actionSecondary) `#201915`: Secondary button fill.
- **on-action-secondary** (actionSecondaryText) `#f1eadf`: Secondary button label.
- **link** (link) `#d2927b`: Link text.
- **focus** (focus) `#d2927b`: Focus indicator.

Status colors (positive, caution, critical, info) are not in this file; take them from compose_design_tokens.

- **small**: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace, weight 400, 0.8225rem, line height 1.75, measure 72ch, paragraph spacing 1em

## Layout

Spacing tokens: unit 4px, stack 12px, gutter 12px, row 32px, section 32px. Density: compact.

### Page structure

- **Opening:** A typed title page rather than a split: on a finely grained desk a folio meta row runs across the top like a page header, the JetBrains Mono 700 headline (2-4rem, ink) and a 0.94rem/1.75 lede within 56ch sit flush left under it, and the filed index card that previews the actual issue, essay, or record hangs from the header rule at the right margin (align-self: start), its folio strip continuing the header line. No image; the eye goes from the headline to the card's folio strip and the rust filing mark at its foot.
- **Grid:** Bands stack in a single column with clamp(20px,3vw,36px) side padding and hairline seams; the reading sheet is the only centred block (max-width 720px, padding clamp(36px,5vw,64px)), holding about 64 characters per line at 0.96rem mono, and everything else stays flush left on the 12px gutter and 32px section step.
- **Density:** Low: one sheet or card per screen, mono at 0.94-0.96rem with 1.75-1.8 line-height and 16px between paragraphs, and wide grained margins around the 720px sheet; the compact 12px gutter shows only inside ledger rows.
- **Type scale:** JetBrains Mono in every role and no italic anywhere: display 700 at 2-4rem and -0.02em (about four times the 0.94rem body), h2 at 1.4-2rem, labels at 0.7-0.74rem uppercase with 0.12-0.22em tracking, and tabular figures for folios and point sizes; emphasis is weight or one rust underline.
- **Section order:**
  1. Title-page opening: folio header rule, mono headline and lede, the filed card hanging from the header rule
  2. The sheet: one long-form text on a lifted paper object, about 64 characters per line
  3. Contents ledger: folio numbers, titles, and press specs on dotted rules
  4. Press notes: an upright mono quote behind a 4px rust rule, with its source named
  5. Subscribe or order: one underlined action that says what arrives and when
- **Signature moves:**
  - Filed index card hero: Previews the actual artifact (an issue, an essay, track notes, an archive record) as a catalogued object with its provenance in the header line.
  - Lifted paper sheet on grain: Presents the long-form moment (a founder letter, liner notes, a manifesto) as a physical document, which is the product's own proof for an archive or zine.
  - Folio contents ledger: Shows what the archive, issue, or catalogue actually contains, item by item, where an icon feature grid would otherwise summarise it.

### Must-haves on the portfolio home

The style restyles these but never removes them; every first-screen item goes in the opening.

- **Work samples**: Anywhere on the page. Show at least 3 pieces of work, as images or as a headed list of linked projects.
- **Contact**: Anywhere on the page. Give a direct way to reach a person: an email or phone link, a contact form, or a link to the contact page.

## Elevation & Depth

Shadows, as CSS box-shadow values:

- **sm**: `none`
- **md**: `0 26px 70px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.32)`
- **lg**: `0 26px 70px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.32)`

## Shapes

Corner radius: sm 2px, md 2px, lg 2px. Borders: 1px solid.

## Components

Each component names its text color and the background it sits on.

- **body-canvas**: primary on surface — Body copy on the page
- **body-panel**: primary on surface-container — Body copy in a panel
- **muted-panel**: secondary on surface-container — Supporting copy in a panel
- **button-primary**: on-action-primary on action-primary — Primary button label
- **button-secondary**: on-action-secondary on action-secondary — Secondary button label
- **input-placeholder**: secondary on surface-container-high — Input placeholder
- **link-canvas**: link on surface — Link text
- **selection**: on-accent-secondary on accent-secondary — Selected item label
- **accent-fill**: on-accent on accent — Text on an accent fill.
- **focus-ring**: focus — Focus ring color.

Non-text pairs, which need 3:1 against their background:
- outline on surface-container-high — Essential input boundary
- focus on surface — Focus indicator adjacent to canvas
- focus on surface-container — Focus indicator adjacent to panel
- outline-variant on surface — Decorative separator, not a control boundary

## Do's and Don'ts

- Do: Set the body role in a monospace face. (style rule typeface)
- Do: Use at most 1 accent hue(s) and keep everything else neutral. (style rule accent-hues)
- Do: Keep the corner radius of cards, panels, buttons, inputs, and images at 2px or less. (style rule corner-radius)
- Don't: Centered hero over a gradient blob (pattern gradient-blob-hero)
- Don't: All-text centered stack (pattern centered-stack-hero)
- Don't: Stock-photo hero (pattern stock-photo-hero)
- Don't: Logo strip (pattern logo-strip)
- Don't: Generic “trusted by” band (pattern trusted-by-band)
- Don't: Icon feature cards (pattern icon-feature-grid)
- Don't: Testimonial carousel (pattern testimonial-carousel)
- Don't: Generic closing CTA banner (pattern closing-cta-banner)
- Don't: Generic SaaS page skeleton (pattern generic-saas-skeleton)
